name: audit-a-selenoprotein-model-ends-at-its-sec-codon
turns: The T. gondii GT1 model of selenoprotein K, TGGT1_316600, gives a shorter protein than its ME49 ortholog TGME49_316600. Is the GT1 gene model right?
rationale: A positive of the answer key: the GT1 model stops at the codon that encodes selenocysteine. The audit keeps the error on the GT1 gene and names selenocysteine in its cause.
